text_en: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.
text_cn: 我是原野的水仙，谷中的百合。

text_en: As a lily among brambles, so is my love among maidens.
text_cn: 我的爱卿在少女中，有如荆棘中的一朵百合花。

text_en: As an apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among young men. With great delight I sat in his shadow, and his fruit was sweet to my taste.
text_cn: 我的爱人在少年中，有如森林中的一棵苹果树；我爱坐在他的荫下，他的果实令我满口香甜。

text_en: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his intention toward me was love.
text_cn: 他引我进入酒室，他插在我身上的旗帜是爱情。

text_en: Sustain me with raisins, refresh me with apples; for I am faint with love.
text_cn: 请你们用葡萄干来补养我，用苹果来苏醒我，因为我因爱成疾：

text_en: O that his left hand were under my head, and that his right hand embraced me!
text_cn: 他的左手在我头下，他的右手紧抱着我。

text_en: I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem, by the gazelles or the wild does: do not stir up or awaken love until it is ready!
text_cn: 耶路撒冷女郎！我指着田野间的羚羊或牝（pìn）鹿，恳求你们，不要惊醒，不要唤醒我的爱，让她自便吧！

text_en: The voice of my beloved! Look, he comes, leaping upon the mountains, bounding over the hills.
text_cn: 听，这是我爱人的声音；看，他来了：跳过山岗，跃过丘陵。

text_en: My beloved is like a gazelle or a young stag. Look, there he stands behind our wall, gazing in at the windows, looking through the lattice.
text_cn: 我的爱人仿佛羚羊，宛如幼鹿；你看，他已站在我们的墙后，由窗外向里凝视，由窗棂往内窥望。

text_en: My beloved speaks and says to me: “Arise, my love, my fair one, and come away;
text_cn: 我的爱人招呼我说：“起来，我的爱卿！快来，我的佳丽！

text_en: for now the winter is past, the rain is over and gone.
text_cn: 看，严冬已过，时雨止息，且已过去；

text_en: The flowers appear on the earth; the time of singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.
text_cn: 田间的花卉已露，歌唱的时期已近。在我们的地方已听到斑鸠声；

text_en: The fig tree puts forth its figs, and the vines are in blossom; they give forth fragrance. Arise, my love, my fair one, and come away.
text_cn: 无花果树已发出初果， 葡萄树已开花放香；起来，我的爱卿！快来，我的佳丽！

text_en: O my dove, in the clefts of the rock, in the covert of the cliff, let me see your face, let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet, and your face is lovely.
text_cn: 我那在岩石缝中，在悬崖隐处的鸽子！请让我看到你的面貌，听见你的声音，因为你的声音柔和可爱，你的面貌美丽动人。”

text_en: Catch us the foxes, the little foxes, that ruin the vineyards— for our vineyards are in blossom. ”
text_cn: 请你们为我们捕捉狐狸，捕捉毁坏葡萄园的小狐狸，我们的葡萄园正在开花啊！

text_en: My beloved is mine and I am his; he pastures his flock among the lilies.
text_cn: 我的爱人属于我，我属于我的爱人；他在百合花间，牧放他的羊群。

text_en: Until the day breathes and the shadows flee, turn, my beloved, be like a gazelle or a young stag on the cleft mountains.
text_cn: 趁晚风还未生凉，日影还未消失，我的爱人，愿你仿效盟约山上的羚羊或幼鹿，向我归来！
